profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
A full 3 day workshop opportunity excites me much more than 2 hours lecture.
Last three days of my life were the best. I trained 40+ faculty with PhD’s and
average 10 years teaching experience. Electrical Engineering was my first
love. And “Data science application in Electrical Engineering” is a
‘Goosebumps’ topic for me to deliver. While corporates are struggling to
organize trainings, a bold college in Hyderabad organised this 3 day ‘Faculty
Development Workshop’ for which I was a sole resource person. Bdw, guys am not
hyping this topic. Load forecasting models are as old as best neural networks.
Engaging working professionals is a challenge. Imagine what if the audience
are teachers, domain experts. It was an intimidating task. 24 hours long
content with applications, from scratch implementations coupled with hands on
is very exhausting to prepare and finally 160 kms of travel every day and
record low temperatures in Hyderabad. Nevertheless, the passion to teach and
quest for challenge won !! Received the best of my life’s compliments.
Extremely humbled to share this with you. Best gift on the second anniversary
of me becoming a Data Scientist from an Optimization engineer.

Last week a telemarketer from Zomato called me. He was promoting their Gold
membership and was insisting that I was missing once in a lifetime
opportunity. He asked whether I was a veg/non veg and even gave examples of
how I would get a 'Butter Chicken' free with ' Tandoori Chicken' for a year! I
did not hang up for a minute or so because I felt that for them, targets and
number of calls matter. When I said I was not interested in the scheme, he
asked me to pass the phone to my parents so that they can make me understand
this valuable opportunity that I was missing. I found this a bit odd
considering the fact that I was an earning independent member of my family.
They should have done better research on their user base. How could he have
handled it better? Thoughts? :) hashtag#marketing hashtag#zomato hashtag#calls

post_content:
The interviewer goes through Data Scientist CV Interviewer: You have excellent
achievements. Tell me one single reason for this success? DS: Boosting
Interviewer: Can you please elaborate? DS: Sir, I owe all this success to my
Manager’s Boosting Interviewer: Oh really! That’s interesting!! So how does he
boost you? DS: Sir, the same way the boosting in ensemble works. Every week he
sets certain tasks. At the end of the week, during the weekly review, the
wrongly accomplished tasks get very high weight (like misclassified points).
This process is repeated over and over every week until I come up with
everything perfect. The interviewer in his late 40’s started thinking when did
his wife learn Data Science hashtag#sunday hashtag#fun hashtag#datascience
hashtag#wayoflife
